en.name: Eucharistic Miracle of Peshtigo
en.summary: A priest saved the Blessed Sacrament from the deadliest wildfire in American history.
en.body: During the Peshtigo Fire of 1871, the deadliest wildfire in United States history, a local priest is said to have pulled his church's tabernacle to safety in a wagon and lowered it into the Peshtigo River. The tabernacle and its contents were found intact the next morning amid total devastation, an event the priest later documented but stopped short of calling a miracle.
